from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's diluted earnings per share from their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company's full name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock security code")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="The diluted earnings per share value in yuan per share")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEPSRecord]
